claims.statement: For independent cap-one product banks X,Y, rank-one B=sigma u v^T with max_i u_i^2<=1/2, arbitrary coordinate-separable sum_i W_i(X_i), and arbitrary measurable H(Y), T=sum_i W_i(X_i)+2X^TBY+H(Y) satisfies sup_w E|T-w|^{-1/2} <= 2^(11/4) B(u)^(1/2) sigma^(-1/2) <= 2^(11/4)e^(1/4)sigma^(-1/2).

If a disjoint external variable Z has density cap K_Z, then Q=T+a(Z+m(X,Y))^2 has an essentially bounded density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2^(11/4)K_Z B(u)^(1/2)(|a|sigma)^(-1/2), hence a linear interval bound. Continuity is not claimed.

For the explicit B20 Hadamard spike/dust target family A_M=[[0,D_M,0],[D_M^T,0,0],[0,0,ww^T]], fleet02/B18 one-sided-cross half-Riesz plus a disjoint square gives ||p||_infinity <=8sqrt(2) M^(-1/4)<3.364 for M>=128. The family remains a counterexample only to robust second-singular-value extraction, not to QFORM.

After paid exits, control the N3 spike/dust or degree-dropped packet when the third spectral resource overlaps the spike/dust banks and both candidate coefficient banks carry genuinely nonseparable curvature; retain product provenance and do not replace the third direction by a worst conditional density cap.
